Risk to check: the old class inherited from ExampleConfigDefaults and DefaultConfig, which are defined outside this file and were not provided. The new model_config only contains CLI_SHELL_COMPLETION_ENABLE, so any settings those two bases contribute are no longer applied to Options. Their definitions (in pydantic_cli/examples/__init__.py and pydantic_cli/__init__.py, or wherever they live) need to be checked. If they are v1-style Config classes, they should be migrated to ConfigDict dicts as well, and the merged dict should be passed here, for example `model_config = ConfigDict(**ExampleConfigDefaults_dict, CLI_SHELL_COMPLETION_ENABLE=...)`. I did not make that change because the base contents are not visible in this file.

The other class-level config keys are not in this file, so no other edits are needed. The Field(..., cli=...) usages are not v1 APIs in this file, so they are left alone."}
